previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Envelope parsing is not total for malformed native output and accepts bool count equality
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: A complete actual JSON line has the claimed schema/data but omits file_name/route/bytes/sha256, or supplies bytes=True for a one-byte body.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: The parser catches decoding errors but directly indexes several unvalidated fields afterward, raising KeyError rather than preserving a malformed fragment. Python True == 1 can also set actual_body_matches_own_envelope true for an invalid boolean byte count. Malformed output and weak types must not become intact-envelope evidence.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Validate the complete exact envelope and expected-record schema/types/bounds before comparison, retain malformed rows/fragments with their real hash/reason, and require type(bytes) is int excluding bool. Keep original ledger/caller/closure requirements and human_read UNCONFIRMED.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static schema/exception/type defect; no simulated positive output or candidate oracle function executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Exact native frozen schema8 fields + genuine nested route/authority types/bounds; duplicate/nonfinite/deep/malformed/missing fragments retained with real bytes/hash/reason; expected records validated before comparison; int bytes excludes bool and all authority numeric scalars strict. Original actual ledger/full caller/close mandatory; human_read UNCONFIRMED.
